svg.text: verified = current-release run · supported = compatible toolchain, no run · historical = earlier release or predecessor
blocked = upstream/physical limit · not routed = launcher exclusion · unverified = current release lacks cell evidence. Hover for detail.
Rendering needs RT cores (L40S or RTX PRO 6000). Current public runtimes are linux/amd64, so aarch64 gpu-gb300 is uncovered.
